steps.title: Count parallel calls per response, show the foldable reads, sharpen the role line
steps.done_when: `python3 scripts/measure-steps.py --since 2026-09-26 --until 2026-10-13` prints a multi-call share above 5 % and a foldable-read row, `_common.md` carries the new line in place of the old, and `mc gate` is green.
instruction: The bug. Claude Code writes each content block of one model response as its own transcript line, all with the same `message.id`. `walk` in `scripts/measure-steps.py` counts `len(uses) > 1` per line, so it can never see a response with two calls. Rewrite `walk` to collect assistant lines into responses keyed by `message['id']` (skip lines without an id, `message['model'] == '<synthetic>'` and events with `isSidechain` true), keeping first-seen order; a response's calls are the `tool_use` blocks of all its lines, and its usage is the `usage` of its last line. Keep `think` and the per-call rows exactly as they are now.

Foldable reads. A response is a *read* when it carries exactly one call and that call is native `Read`, `Grep` or `Glob`, or a `Bash` call `classify` puts in `read/search`. A read is *foldable* when the response just before it in the same session is also a read and the call's input names nothing the previous call's result contains: take every token of the input's string values matching `[\w./-]{6,}` that contains `/` or `.`, and the read is foldable when none of them occurs in the previous result's text (text blocks only). Its saving is that response's `cache_read_input_tokens` at 0.1× the input price of its model (the `PRICES` table already in the script). `walk` returns, beside `rows` and `think`: responses with at least one call, responses with two or more, foldable count, and foldable USD.

Output. Replace the `turns with more than one tool call` quantiles row in `main` with two lines: `responses with ≥2 tool calls  <multi>/<responses> (<pct>)` summed over the window, and `foldable single reads  <n> requests, <usd> USD = <pct> of the window's cost`, where the window's cost is the sum of `total_cost_usd` over the sessions that have a transcript. Note in a comment above the counting why it groups by message id.

Docs. In `docs/technical/mc-run.md` (the paragraph beginning '`scripts/measure-steps.py --since <day or instant> --until <day>` is the instrument'), replace 'the turns that carried more than one tool call, which is the number that says whether a session batches' with 'the responses (one `message.id`, however many transcript lines claude wrote for it) that carried more than one tool call, and the single-call reads that could have shared a response with the read before them, priced as the cache read they cost — counted per line before 2026-10-12, which always gave 0'.

The role line. In `canon/roles/_common.md` replace the line pair '- Independent Bash commands in one call; independent `Read`s and `Edit`s in
  one message.' with: '- Before you read, name everything you will need — files, patterns, ranges —
  and ask for all of it in one response: several `Read`/`Grep` calls side by
  side, not one per turn. Only a call that needs the previous result waits
  for it. Independent `Edit`s, likewise, in one response.' Keep the list's other two bullets. If a test pins the old wording (`grep -rn "Independent Bash commands" tests`), update it.
Check: run the command in done_when on this machine and paste its two new lines into the PR body.
